AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hour' END ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH / AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' days ' END ELSE CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME)) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME)) > 1 THEN TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH / AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' day ' || TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hours' ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH / AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' day ' || TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hour' END ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.APPLY_LENGTH / AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' day ' END END ELSE CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME)) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME)) > 1 THEN TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hours' ELSE TO_CHAR(MOD(A.APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HR.PERSON_ID, A.ORDER_TIME))) || ' hour' END ELSE '0 hour' END END END ATT_LENGTH, CASE WHEN A.APPLY_LENGTH > 1 THEN A.APPLY_LENGTH || ' hours' ELSE A.APPLY_LENGTH || ' hour' END SELECT S.SEQ, S.AFFIRM_TYPE, DECODE(S.AFFIRM_TYPE, 4, 0, 1) ASSIGN_TYPE, S.APPLY_TYPE, S.APPLY_FLAG, E.EMPID AFFIRM_EMPID, (SELECT HR.EMAIL FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO HR WHERE E.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID) EMAIL, S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID, S.TITLE, S.AFFIRM_LEVEL, CASE WHEN S.APPLY_TYPE_CODE = '31' THEN TO_CHAR(DECODE(S.AFFIRM_TYPE, 4, 0, 1)) ELSE S.AFFIRM_LEVEL END AFFIRM_LEVEL_FORMAT, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL)) - 1 ROW_LEVEL, S.AFFIRM_FLAG, S.APPLY_AFFIRM_FLAG, S.ACTIVITY FROM SY_AFFIRM_EMAIL S, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND S.APPLY_NO = #{APPLY_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S.AFFIRM_TYPE != 3 AND S.AFFIRM_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL

SELECT S.SEQ, S.AFFIRM_TYPE, DECODE(S.AFFIRM_TYPE, 3, 'referer', 'receiver') RECEIVER_TYPE, S.APPLY_TYPE, S.APPLY_FLAG, E.EMPID AFFIRM_EMPID, S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID, S.TITLE, S.AFFIRM_LEVEL, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL)) - 1 ROW_LEVEL, S.AFFIRM_FLAG, S.APPLY_AFFIRM_FLAG, S.ACTIVITY FROM SY_AFFIRM_EMAIL S, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID = E.PERSON_ID AND S.APPLY_NO = #{APPLY_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S.AFFIRM_TYPE IN (3, 4) ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL

SELECT A.APPLY_NO, A.MISDOCID, A.REMARK FROM ( SELECT TB.APPLY_NO, TB.MISDOCID, TB.LEAVE_REASON REMARK FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB TB WHERE TB.AFFIRM_FLAG = '14014310' AND TB.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TB.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND TB.APPLY_NO IN (${APPLY_NOS}) UNION ALL SELECT OT.APPLY_NO, OT.MISDOCID, OT.APPLY_OT_REMARK REMARK FROM ESS_APPLY_OT OT WHERE OT.AFFIRM_FLAG = '14014310' AND OT.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND OT.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND OT.APPLY_NO IN (${APPLY_NOS}) UNION ALL SELECT OTV.APPLY_NO, OTV.MISDOCID, OTV.APPLY_OT_REMARK REMARK FROM ESS_APPLY_OT_OVER OTV WHERE OTV.AFFIRM_FLAG = '14014310' AND OTV.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND OTV.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND OTV.APPLY_NO IN (${APPLY_NOS}) UNION ALL SELECT CARD.APPLY_NO, CARD.MISDOCID, CARD.APPLY_REASON REMARK FROM ESS_CARD_APPLY_TB CARD WHERE CARD.AFFIRM_FLAG = '14014310' AND CARD.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CARD.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND CARD.APPLY_NO IN (${APPLY_NOS}) UNION ALL SELECT A.APPLY_NO, A.MISDOCID, A.REMARK FROM EDU_TRAINING_REGISTER A WHERE A.AFFIRM_FLAG = '14014310' AND A.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND A.APPLY_NO IN (${APPLY_NOS}) ) A

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ATT.APPLY_NO, ATT.PERSON_ID, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, (CASE WHEN ( TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'HH24:MI'), 'HH24:MI') > TO_DATE(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(GET_AR_SHIFT_TIME(GET_AR_SHIFTNO(ATT.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'HAE'), TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'HAE', 'FIRST'), 0, 16), 12, 16), 'HH24:MI') ) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) TIME_FLAG, ATT.BATCH_YN, ATT.BATCH_NO, ATT.MISDOCID FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB ATT WHERE ATT.AFFIRM_FLAG NOT IN ('14014308', '14014309', '14014310') AND ATT.CPNY_ID = 'HAE' AND ATT.ACTIVITY = 1 AND ATT.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND ATT.MISDOCID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT OT.APPLY_NO, OT.PERSON_ID, OT.OT_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, OT.OT_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, '0' TIME_FLAG, OT.BATCH_YN, OT.BATCH_NO, OT.MISDOCID FROM ESS_APPLY_OT OT WHERE OT.AFFIRM_FLAG NOT IN ('14014308', '14014309', '14014310') AND OT.CPNY_ID = 'HAE' AND OT.ACTIVITY = 1 AND OT.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND OT.MISDOCID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT OTO.APPLY_NO, OTO.PERSON_ID, OTO.OT_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, OTO.OT_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, '0' TIME_FLAG, OTO.BATCH_YN, OTO.BATCH_NO, OTO.MISDOCID FROM ESS_APPLY_OT_OVER OTO WHERE OTO.AFFIRM_FLAG NOT IN ('14014308', '14014309', '14014310') AND OTO.CPNY_ID = 'HAE' AND OTO.ACTIVITY = 1 AND OTO.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND OTO.MISDOCID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CARD.APPLY_NO, CARD.PERSON_ID, '218197' APPLY_TYPE_NO, CARD.ITEM_NO APPLY_TYPE_CODE, '0' TIME_FLAG, 0 BATCH_YN, 0 BATCH_NO, CARD.MISDOCID FROM ESS_CARD_APPLY_TB CARD WHERE CARD.AFFIRM_FLAG NOT IN ('14014308', '14014309', '14014310') AND CARD.CPNY_ID = 'HAE' AND CARD.ACTIVITY = '1' AND CARD.SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 1 AND CARD.MISDOCID IS NOT NULL ) A ORDER BY A.APPLY_NO

SELECT ATT.APPLY_NO, ATT.PERSON_ID, HR.LOCAL_NAME, HR.EMPID, GET_DEPT_NAME(HR.DEPTNO, 'vi') DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HR.POSITION_NO, 'vi') POSITION_NAME, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_NO APPLY_TYPE_NO, ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE APPLY_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, 'vi') APPLY_TYPE_NAME_VI, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(ATT.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, 'ko') APPLY_TYPE_NAME_KO, TO_CHAR(ATT.APPLY_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') APPLY_TIME, TO_CHAR(ATT.APPLY_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ORDER_TIME, TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(ATT.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') TO_TIME, ATT.APPLY_LENGTH, ATT.LEAVE_REASON REMARK, ATT.BATCH_YN, ATT.BATCH_NO, ATT.MISDOCID FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB ATT, HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE ATT.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID AND ATT.APPLY_NO = #{paramMap.APPLY_NO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ATT.ATTENDACE_FLAG IS NULL

SELECT A.SEQ, A.APPLY_NO, A.APPLY_TYPE, A.APPLY_FLAG, A.APPLY_PERSON_ID, A.APPLY_TYPE_CODE, A.SEND_FLAG, A.EMAIL_TITLE, REPLACE(A.EMAIL_CONTENT, '[MAIL_LOGIN_EMPID]', HRE.EMPID) EMAIL_CONTENT, HR.EMAIL, HRE.EMPID MAIL_LOGIN_EMPID, TO_CHAR(A.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY') YEAR FROM SY_AFFIRM_EMAIL A, HR_PERSONAL_INFO HR, HR_EMPLOYEE HRE WHERE A.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID AND A.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID AND A.SEND_FLAG IN (0, 3)
